blurb: Leaps and Bounds Dance Academy offers year-round dance classes for children and teens, focusing on performance rather than competition. Classes build confidence, technique, and social skills through various dance styles and levels. Enrollment includes tuition, recital costumes, tights, showcase leotard or t-shirt, and production fees bundled in a monthly payment.
extraNote: Enrollment fee $25 per person. · Sibling discount $5 per month after first paying dancer for each immediate family member enrolled. · Autopay required through parent portal; $10 fee for card failure on first occurrence; $15 late fee if paid after 15th of the month. · Worry-free enrollment: cancel autopay with no further obligation if not satisfied after four classes. · Year-round
